question: Shyamamani Devi was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for her contributions to _________ music.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odishi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shyamamani Devi** was awarded the **Padma Shri** in **2022** for her contributions to **Odishi music**.
 
• Odishi music is a classical music genre originating from the Indian state of **Odisha**.
 
• It is known for its melodious and intricate compositions, often accompanying the classical dance form of **Odissi**.
 
• Shyamamani Devi has been a pivotal figure in promoting and preserving this traditional form of music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, awarded to citizens for distinguished contributions in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Odissi music, along with Odissi dance, is an integral part of the cultural heritage of Odisha and has a rich tradition spanning centuries.
 
• Shyamamani Devi's contributions have been instrumental in keeping the legacy of Odissi music alive and inspiring the next generation of musicians.
